Additionally, have you noticed any joint pain, swelling, or a rash on your face, specifically a butterfly rash across the cheeks?

Given his smoking history and these symptoms, we must rule out vasculitis or connective tissue disease. Have you noticed any skin ulcers, nosebleeds, or cough with blood?
